title: Professional Certificate Course in Understanding Statement of Cash flow and Non-financial Statements
description: This course is designed to help individuals understand the statement of cash flow and non-financial statements.
longDescription: Understand the concept of cash flow in a business, its recording process, and the types of transactions for the cash flow. Understand the Classification of Cash Flows based on the types of financial activities. Understand the nature and structure of the cash flow Statement. Understand the nature and structure of the Equity statement. Understand the role of non-financial statements and reports. This course aims to provide a solid understanding of financial statements beyond the traditional income statement and balance sheet. Students will learn the purpose and importance of the statement of cash flows and non-financial statements, such as the statement of changes in equity and notes to the financial statements. modules.title: Understanding Statement Of Cash Flow And Non-financial Statements
modules.summary: This course is designed to help individuals understand the statement of cash flow and non-financial statements. Participants will learn how to analyze financial statements and interpret the information presented in these documents. The course will cover key concepts such as cash flow management, liquidity ratios, and non-financial performance indicators. By the end of this course, participants will have a solid understanding of how to use financial statements to make informed business decisions.
